proposals.evidence: The full CDIAL 8249 prose explicitly separates a -ḍa extension, represented in Jambu by 8249-2 *pucchaḍa: Sindhi puchaṛu/puchiṛī, western Pahari põchaṛ, Nepali puchar and Gujarati puchṛũ tail. The selected pucar/pucəḍ/puciṛ forms fit that extended branch; aspiration, affricate notation, dental/retroflex rhotics and endings remain qualified and unchanged. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Citation is to the entry prose, not its unrelated numbered nasal addendum. Exact response: pucəḍu.
